name: Run N' Gun (Trabajo Final)
author: Olra
description:
Please turn on the sound for a better experience (click on the volume icon and then click inside the game)
Details: The character has 5 lives. When you lose one, you will have a 4 second cooldown. When you lose all your 5 lives, you will go to the "Try Again" screen, you can press Start here to reappear at the start of the level or one of the 2 checkpoints. Fullscreen can only be played on a 16:9 monitor.
Start/Spacebar: Start or restart the level, Pause the game
Arrows: Walk, crouch, aim with your weapon
X: JumpㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤC: Shoot (Hold to shoot automatically, except for the default weapon)ㅤㅤㅤ
Hold Z: Aim at 8 directions without walking
